additions.what: Emphasized that the fundamental challenge is predicting unobserved counterfactual outcomes (one missing potential outcome) rather than directly predicting treatment effects
additions.why: The student treats both potential outcomes symmetrically and jumps directly to ITE prediction, missing that counterfactual inference is the paper's primary building block

additions.what: Re-added desirable property about maintaining validity when key components are imperfectly estimated
additions.why: The doubly robust property is a major theoretical contribution that the student missed - the method works if either propensity scores OR outcome models are accurate
